distribution.summary: 江苏；上海；浙江；福建；江西
distribution.narrative: Occurrence in mainland China was initially confirmed by the original description from Jiangsu and Shanghai. Li et al. (2021) added positive field-survey records from Zhejiang, Fujian, Jiangxi, Jiangsu and Shanghai; Tan et al. (2021) independently documented Jiujiang, Jiangxi. MaxEnt-predicted suitable areas are not treated as occurrence records.
distribution.evidence: Integrated source records GaoCognato2018_001, LiEtAl2021_001 and TanEtAl2021_001.

host_note: Liquidambar styraciflua is reported in the original description; later reviewed sources add L. formosana and L. gracilipes.
taxonomy_summary: Acanthotomicus suncei was described as a new species by Gao & Cognato (2018). The currently accepted scientific name remains Acanthotomicus suncei Cognato, 2018.

taxonomic_history.name: Acanthotomicus suncei
taxonomic_history.note: Original description, p. 596; retained as the current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: This species was described in 2018 and is new relative to the 2015 Chinese baseline.

resources.images: No image records are linked yet.
resources.specimens: Type material from Jiangsu and Shanghai is documented in the original description; dedicated specimen records are not yet linked.
